programs.description: Julia journeys to the Indo-Burma border to perform for the troops during World War II, on the insistence of Billimoria, her lover. There, she finds herself enamoured by Jemadar Malik, a soldier.
The heir to a large estate is killed by his conniving relatives. Meanwhile, his lookalike, a gangster, falls in love with a singer and impersonates a software engineer to impress her.
A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.
Dr Das, a reserved man, finds his routine life upended when Deva, a fugitive gangster on the run from police, seeks refuge in his clinic. Over time, a profound friendship blossoms between them.
After the end of his romance with Parvati, Arun befriends Cathy, John's girlfriend. Things take a chaotic turn when John mistakes their bond for love instead of friendship.
Accused of his wife's murder in an alleged honor killing, Rudra Prabhakaran is jailed. Subsequently, he descends into a dark path of vengeance after posting bail.
Periyasamy's sons decide to visit him with their families. While Eeswaran, his caretaker, oversees the preparations for this visit, he takes it upon himself to protect the family from danger.
Pradeep's life turns upside down when he is accused of a murder after discovering the dead body of an influential villager along with some precious jewels.
A dying criminal enlists a rogue scientist to transfer his mind into a savvy street renegade, using a special brain port. Chaos and adventure ensue!

Gang leader Sakthivel adopts Amaran after a gang war, but years later, a survivor from an assassination attempt sparks doubt. Soon, Sakthivel suspects Amaran, igniting a conflict of loyalty and revenge.
Madhu, traumatised by the sudden deaths of his father and girlfriend, tries to commit suicide, but is rescued by a stranger who looks exactly like him and transported to a distant planet.
Kathir, an architect with a carefree attitude, falls for Nandhini. However, his troubled childhood with his unfaithful mother creates challenges in his relationship.
A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.
Ramakrishnan, a police constable, is posted as a driver at Elathur women police station. He has to deal with the fiery sub-inspector, Arundhathi Varma, to save his job.
Jeeva, who has a natural talent in cricket, dreams of playing for the Indian cricket team. However, his love life and politics in the sports governing body become obstacles to his ambition.
A desperate smuggler finds himself strapped for cash. Later, when an agent offers him a fortune to extradite a notorious drug lord from Malaysia, he accepts only to face a world of betrayal.
An army official sets out for Kurnool after being assigned a covert mission. Soon, he finds himself in the middle of uncovering a major scam.
Chezhiyan, the spoilt son of a minister, commits crimes but gets away with it. However, he is soon abducted by Easan and ACP Sangayya investigates the case only to stumble upon disturbing truths.
A seasoned police officer begins an investigation after a series of gruesome murders targeting twins comes to light. However, he soon encounters a sinister game of psychological manipulation.
An inspector covertly collaborates with his brother to discipline offenders, but when a gangster uncovers their secret, the officer resolves to train under his sibling to confront the criminal.
Rocket Raja, a small-time thief, comes across a young girl who calls him father. However, when Raja finds the truth about the girl's past, he turns into a vigilante.
Bharath, a surgeon working in the US, embarks on a mission to India, to find his biological parents and reconcile with them.
A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.
Parvathy is hesitant to accept her brother, Saravanan, who returns home after 15 years. Soon, she discovers that not everything is as it seems and uncovers a well-planned conspiracy.
After moving into a hostel in Bangalore for their engineering course, three teenagers get into a terrible brawl with their seniors. To exact revenge, they decide to befriend a gangster.
An ex-convict's fresh start to life is threatened by vengeful enemies, compelling him to confront the dangers for a chance at freedom.
Jai Simha Reddy, the son of the esteemed Veera Simha Reddy, returns home to avenge his father's death as a result of village politics.
After his mother is mercilessly killed, young Kittu is adopted by an elderly man. As he grows older and is left to look after himself, he resolves to find his mother's killer.
An ordinary IAS aspirant, who helps out many misguided youths in his locality and shares a close bond with his mother, takes on a huge challenge when he opposes a powerful miscreant.
Akash, a simple man, falls in love with politician Gajapathi's daughter, Meera. However, on learning the identity of Akash's father, Gajapathi suspects that he wants revenge for a past transgression.

The lives of several families become intertwined, including a young couple who bond over chess, a taxi driver anxiously hoping for his pregnant wife to deliver a baby boy, and a kind-hearted man managing an orphanage.
A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.
Pandian Pazhanisami, a retired man, misses his youthful days and embarks on a mission to find his first love and reconnect with her.

Subhash, a daredevil officer, raises his voice against injustice when he comes across a few politically influential people. However, when his family is brutally murdered, he sets out to exact revenge.
After learning that his father was brutally killed by Bhallaladeva, Mahendra Baahubali raises an army to defeat him and release his mother from the former's captivity.
A police officer looks into an informer who can predict future murders in a mysterious way. Soon, she unearths a sinister murder mystery that leads to a shocking truth.
A brave thief fights to survive and claim his territory. However, he battles powerful enemies, aiming to become a leader without a real kingdom.

When terrorists hijack a plane from Chennai, a struggle with the pilots damages the engine forcing them to make an emergency landing in Tirupati. NSG commando Ravi is entrusted with rescue operations.
Karthika and Jeeva, two college-going students, fall in love with each other but are forced to separate by their families. However, when they try to reunite, tragedy strikes.
Five juveniles stop at Renigunta after escaping from Madurai's correctional facility. Subsequently, they encounter a mysterious figure who introduces them to the dark underbelly of organised crime.

Vijay is the right-hand man of a gangster, Kali. However, when Kali's brother gets Vijay killed because of his rising popularity, Shiva sets out to avenge his brother's murder.
Autorickshaw driver Sakthi is head-over-heels in love with his neighbour, Leena. His world spirals into chaos when three ruthless criminals threaten his life.
A happy-go-lucky man is forced to adopt violent means to avenge his parents' ruthless murders. So, with the help of his love, he sets out to punish the culprits.
Kemban abandons his adopted grandfather in a forest to die at the hands of an animal, so that he would be compensated by the forest department. But the old man keeps surviving, which annoys Kemban.
Varun, an NRI medical student, and Bhanu, a vivacious, young woman, fall in love with each other. However, they face many personal differences that create complications in their relationship.
Arivu and his trainee friends face the wrath of a ruthless trainer, Eshwaramurthy, who later plots schemes to demotivate and punish the entire batch.
Saravanan, an Indian living abroad, struggles to sell his ancestral home in India due to the supposed presence of ghosts in it. He devises a plan to prove that his house is not haunted.
Jeetu, a young man, wants to join the force but is discouraged by his brother-in-law, a police officer. A dejected Jeetu steals his uniform and goes around pretending to be an officer of the law.
A man finds and stores the contact number of his lost childhood love in his phone, which is then stolen by a mafia thug. He then sets out to retrieve the cellphone at all costs.

An officer attempts to solve a vital case in his search for his sister. He begins the investigation, unaware of the heinous secrets that await him.
A group of friends reunite for the wedding of one of their own. However, when a mishap threatens to ruin the event, only a series of cricket matches can save the day.
Birla Bose, an encounter specialist, takes on a rape and murder case in Rameswaram. Upon discovering the accused's innocence, he embarks on a quest to uncover the true perpetrators.
Gana, a former army officer, embarks on a mission to eradicate corruption leading him to confront a dangerous politician and his oppressive empire.
Two young brothers from a Chennai slum dream of tasting pizza, but their journey to fulfill this simple desire reveals the harsh realities of poverty and social inequality.
A police officer goes after a notorious serial killer who has been targeting his fellow police officers.

While doing his mission to eradicate corruption, an undercover journalist experiences a forbidden relationship when he falls in love with a high-profile gangster's daughter.
A revenue inspector falls in love with a girl but faces problems due to his cowardliness. He is compelled to find a way to prove himself to her father, who wants her to marry a brave man.
Guna kidnaps Eeswaran, brother of a minister, for orchestrating violence among students. However, Eeswaran escapes and trails after Guna to exact his revenge.
Two people enter an arranged marriage to please their parents, living as strangers under one roof. However, an unforeseen event prompts them to reassess their relationship and emotions.
A man gains great notoriety in his village for his unmatched strength and brutal nature, which makes him a target of antisocial elements with a ruthless agenda.
Pandiyan, a gang member seeking reform, is framed for murder, forcing him to disguise himself as a wealthy man's missing son to evade danger.
A pair of criminology graduates start a firm to prove the innocence of people wrongly framed and punished for criminal offences.
When ill luck befalls a family, Kathiresan decides to please the gods by offering their pet rooster as a sacrifice. However, things do not go as expected as the rooster goes missing.

Chandran lies to his boss in order to go and watch a football match, but his boss also attends the match and catches him. Later, to save his job, Chandran is forced to lie about having a twin brother.
An unlucky real estate agent experiences a bit of luck when he wins a car in a contest. However, things take a turn after the car is stolen by anonymous assailants.
Upset that his son wants to settle in London, Balaraju has a bitter argument with him. Later, his grandson travels to India to mend the relationship between his father and grandfather.
Two childhood friends lose touch over the years as one grows up to become a national figure while another makes a living out of barbering. Little do they know that a surprise reunion is on the cards.
The son of a brave yet impaired policeman, Murali, dreams of a secure future in banking. However, unforeseen circumstances lead him to follow his father's footsteps in law enforcement.
Kartik sacrifices his studies for his sister and becomes a stuntman. But he ends up helping a cop to unearth the evil designs of Deepak.
Facing a menacing criminal kingpin, Ram fights to protect his family. Soon, he embarks on a daring mission to topple the villain and dismantle his corrupt empire.
